selected_records.title: Catastrophic Forgetting in Sequential Thermal Anti-UAV Detection: The Role of Scale-Conditioned Gradient Imbalance

article.body:
ArXiv paper flags forgetting in sequential thermal anti-UAV detection

An arXiv cs.CV record dated 6 October 2026 lists a paper titled “Catastrophic Forgetting in Sequential Thermal Anti-UAV Detection: The Role of Scale-Conditioned Gradient Imbalance.” The title identifies a detection research topic, not a named counter-drone platform or operational test.

The record provides no abstract, methods or results. It does not establish an autonomy level, identify sensor hardware or payload, or describe a test environment. No demonstrated performance can be distinguished from broader claims on the available evidence. The item is listed as an arXiv paper; production or deployment status is not provided.
